final: WITH media_averages AS (SELECT m.Name AS media_type, AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / t.Milliseconds) AS avg_bytes_per_ms FROM Track AS t JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_ms) AS overall_avg FROM media_averages) SELECT media_type, avg_bytes_per_ms, avg_bytes_per_ms - overall_avg AS above_overall_average FROM media_averages CROSS JOIN overall WHERE avg_bytes_per_ms > overall_avg
